ICS 03.180, 03.080.01, 03.080.99SSD 13New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard specifies categorization of different programmes being offered by skill development service providers in the field of media and entertainment services sector.NOTES1 The skill development services provider is hereinafter called as service provider.2 The service provider can be an institute or an individual recognized by appropriate authority.3 The programmes being considered are the ones with curriculum that suit requirements of various job roles existing in the media and entertainment service industry.4 The programmes may be conducted in physical mode, online mode or a combination thereof with the programme curriculum clearly outlining the mode of learning for each component or course being offered in the programme.
